Virendra Singh Bhoj …………Petitioner
 Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and another ……….Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. T.P.S. Takuli, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned D.A.G. for the State.
3. This Court vide order dated 13.07.2026, passed in 
WPSS No.1773 of 2026, Virendra Singh Bhoj Vs. State of 
Uttarakhand and another, directed respondent no.2 to 
decide representation of the petitioner in light of the 
Government Order dated 15.06.2023 whereby exemption 
can be given to a Government Servant who is unwilling to 
be transferred from remote place to accessible place.
4. Petitioner submitted his representation on 
14.07.2026 to respondent no.2 along with copy of the 
order passed by this Court and the said representation 
was rejected by respondent no.2 vide order dated 
21.07.2026.
5. Feeling aggrieved by the order dated 21.07.2026 the 
petitioner is before this Court.
6. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner 
that respondent no.2 has completely ignored the intent of 
the Government Order dated 15.06.2023 as well as the 
order passed by this Court while rejecting representation 
of the petitioner on the ground that he has not submitted 
his representation before his transfer under the 
Uttarakhand Public Servants Annual Transfer Act, 2017 2
from remote to accessible area.
7. Learned counsel for the State prays for and is 
granted six weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit.
8. List this case on 08.09.2026.
9. In the meantime, the impugned transfer order dated 
30.06.2026 shall remain stayed.
10. Stay Application (IA No.1 of 2026) stands disposed of 
accordingly. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 27.07.2026
SK
